name: Resumable Upload Queue
note: A bandwidth scheduler splits one simulated link between N concurrent uploads, each sent in 8 MB chunks so a dropped connection resumes from the last acknowledged chunk; real files dropped or picked are queued by name and size, the throughput history is a DPR-aware canvas paused off screen, and the overall ring runs on a registered @property. name: Share Dialog with Inherited Access
note: Effective access is computed, not stored: each cell of the people-by-item matrix is the strongest of a direct grant, an inherited folder grant, a group membership or the link setting, so staging one role change repaints every affected cell with its source; changes stay pending with a hatched diff until saved, and each is undoable. name: Version History with Live Diff
note: Every version is a full snapshot and the changes are recomputed with a word-level LCS diff between any two of them, so Shift-click compares arbitrary versions; a change rail maps each edit's position in the document, ] and [ step through them, and restore is non-destructive, adding a new version you can undo.
